description: Governed controlled vocabularies used across the ChatHealthy.ai system. Each vocabulary has a definition, members with definitions, and implementation traceability. Engineering rules (engineering_rules.json, Version 5) are the authoritative standard per GOV-007 (Engineering Rules Are Standards). Vocabularies that duplicate v4 rules have been removed.

vocabularies.name: bad_data_reasons
vocabularies.definition: Controlled reasons for flagging a provider record as having data quality issues. A bad_data record has structural problems that make it unreliable for enrichment or user-facing queries. The record is retained but flagged.

members.definition: Provider has no practice address and no mailing address. Cannot be geocoded or county-enriched.
Provider has an address but it is demonstrably wrong. Zip/state mismatch detected and repair from license data failed for an unclassified reason.
Provider zip code maps to a different state than practice_address.state. License data was checked but did not resolve the conflict.
Zip/state mismatch detected. Provider has multiple license states — cannot determine which is correct.
Zip/state mismatch detected. Provider has no license data to use for repair.

source_files.note: Zip/state mismatch detection and license repair

vocabularies.name: out_of_scope_reasons
vocabularies.definition: Controlled reasons for marking a provider record as out of scope. An out_of_scope record is a valid, good-quality record that falls outside the current processing scope. It is not enriched or embedded but is not deleted.

members.definition: Provider NPI has been deactivated by CMS without subsequent reactivation. The provider is no longer active.
Provider practice address country is set and is not US. Valid provider but outside ChatHealthy.ai's geographic scope.

vocabularies.name: commit_prefixes
vocabularies.definition: Required prefixes on all git commit messages to indicate Claude's operating mode during the work.

members.definition: Claude operating in Normal mode -- standard behavior, best judgment, never break a rule.
Claude operating in Unattended mode -- autonomous, may terminate hung jobs, no secrets unless instructed.
Claude operating in Idiot mode -- step-by-step confirmation, one unit at a time.

vocabularies.name: backlog_work_status
vocabularies.definition: Constrained work status values for epics, features, stories, and requirements in agile_backlog.json. Tracks implementation lifecycle.

members.definition: All work complete but known bugs remain open and are tracked.
Work cannot proceed due to a dependency or blocker.
Intentionally postponed to a later sprint.

vocabularies.name: emergency_keywords
vocabularies.definition: Config-driven keyword list for SafetyService EmergencyDetector. Dual-trigger OR logic: keyword match OR semantic classifier. F-09 fix expanded from v1.0. Categories group keywords by medical emergency type. Each member value is a keyword phrase; the definition is the emergency category.

source_files.note: Dual-trigger: keyword match OR semantic classifier. Loaded at startup from brain JSON.

vocabularies.name: governance_propensity
vocabularies.definition: Immutable governance response labels. Five levels spanning two scopes (system and session). Each label maps to a fixed propensity. Used in the governance matrix — every cell in the matrix must be one of these five values. Labels are subjective assignments today — research story pending to validate each cell.

members.definition: Escalate to a higher authority. The current scope cannot resolve this — requires human intervention or a higher-level governance decision.
members.reason: Required to make governance framework functional and automated.

members.definition: System-level abend. All users, all sessions, all environments stop. The system is non-compliant and must not serve until resolved. Flag set globally — every hook returns continue:false. GOV-015: governance is universal and immediate.
Session-level abend. This Claude session stops (continue:false). System keeps running. Other users unaffected. The session violated a constraint that cannot be recovered within the session.
Environment-aware abend. Check current environment context. Abend if the constraint applies in this environment.
System-level warning. Logged system-wide. Human alerted. All sessions see it. Proceed with caution. The constraint is at risk across the system.
Session-level warning. Logged locally to this session. Claude proceeds with caution. The constraint is relevant but not blocking.
Environment-aware warning. Check current environment context. Warn if the constraint applies in this environment.
Environment-aware display. Show environment context to the user (e.g. red dev banner). Not a warning or risk — presentation behavior.
Good event. Proceed. No action needed. The constraint is either not relevant or fully satisfied.

Behavior is enforced by code. When the governance grid cell has this value, the code implements the specific control sequence defined in the engineering rules — not a generic abend or warning. The code must execute the exact procedure specified in the rule (e.g. v4-004 control sequence: stop, state the violation, request one-time authority, log risk acceptance).
members.reason: These additions to the vocabulary (code_controlled, not_a_problem) are required in order to make our governance framework functional and automated.

members.definition: No risk. Used as a risk_level value when a governance action carries no operational, compliance, or security risk.
members.reason: These additions to the vocabulary (code_controlled, not_a_problem) are required in order to make our governance framework functional and automated.

source_files.note: Governance matrix reads labels to determine compliance response per JSON per action event.

vocabularies.name: bug_type
vocabularies.definition: Constrained severity/type values for bug records in bugs.json. Every bug must have exactly one type.

members.definition: System cannot function. All work stops until resolved.
Major functionality broken. Must fix this sprint.
Significant defect. Fix within two sprints.
Investigated and determined not to be a defect.
Bug has been fixed and verified.

vocabularies.name: bug_resolution_status
vocabularies.definition: Constrained resolution status values for bug records. Tracks lifecycle from discovery through verified fix.

members.definition: Bug is being investigated. Root cause not yet identified.
Root cause identified. Fix in progress.
Fix applied. Pytest required. Fields: pytest_id (required), pytest_success_criteria (from pytest record, required).
Pytest passed. Fields: pytest_id (required), pytest_success_criteria (from pytest record, required).
Bug closed because the requirement it referenced was renumbered or reorganized. The bug is no longer valid against the new requirement structure.
Bug newly reported. Not yet triaged or investigated.
Internal system testing in progress. Developer is actively working on and testing the fix.
Fix complete. Internal system testing underway to verify the fix.
IST passed. User acceptance testing underway with human.
Fix ready for UAT but human has not yet started testing.
Fix failed internal system testing. Returned to fixing.
Fix failed user acceptance testing. Returned to fixing.
Bug acknowledged but intentionally deferred. Will be addressed in a future sprint.
Bug removed from tracking. No longer applicable.
Bug fix verified and confirmed complete.

vocabularies.name: environment
vocabularies.definition: Constrained environment values used across all collections — bugs, governance matrix, deployments, pipeline operations. Universal vocabulary for where things run.
vocabularies.reason: Required to automate governance — environments are used across bugs, governance matrix, deployments, and pipeline operations.

members.definition: Quality assurance environment. GPT sign-off required for promotion.
Production environment. Human sign-off required for promotion.

source_files.note: Constrains which environments a bug exists in.
Defines the environment tiers for governance.

vocabularies.name: backlog_approval_status
vocabularies.definition: Constrained approval status for epics, features, stories, and requirements. Only human can set to approved. Claude and GPT may only propose.
vocabularies.reason: Required to prevent Claude/GPT from self-approving requirements.

members.definition: human has reviewed and approved this item.
Claude or GPT proposed this item. Awaiting human review.
human has reviewed and rejected this item.
